title: Upcoming Xbox Game Pass Title Avoids 'Full Price' Launch Due To How Busy October Is
summary: Valor Mortis is getting priced at $40 instead
text: Upcoming Xbox Game Pass Title Avoids 'Full Price' Launch Due To How Busy October Is | Pure Xbox Menu Search Share Guest Guest Login | Sign Up Pure Xbox News Reviews Features Games Guides Videos Forums Search Keywords Guest Login or Sign Up Home Choose Topics... Manage Topics News Xbox Xbox Game Pass Valor Mortis New Releases Upcoming Xbox Game Pass Title Avoids 'Full Price' Launch Due To How Busy October Is Valor Mortis is getting priced at $40 instead by Fraser Gilbert 4 hours ago Share: We've already talked about how September and October have been ridiculously busy for new releases this year (primarily due to GTA 6 stealing the spotlight for November), and if the publisher of Valor Mortis is to be believed, it's actually led to them reducing the price of their upcoming Xbox Game Pass title to avoid getting lost in the shuffle. In a statement published yesterday, the team explained that they believe they can complete alongside many "full price" releases, but they're concerned about the "stacked" fall lineup and how "there's high demand for your time and money". As a result, they've decided to price the game at $39.99 from day one. However, there is also a Deluxe Edition for $59.99 that includes story DLC launching next year. "We believe the game has the quality, fidelity, and playtime in its 20-hour story to go toe-to-toe with many "full price" titles. Still, this Fall is stacked and there's high demand for your time and money. That's why Valor Mortis is launching on October 13 at $39.99 / €39.99 / 149.99 zł." Valor Mortis will be $39.99. Here’s why. pic.twitter.com/uzm520sFz1 - Valor Mortis (@ValorMortis) September 17, 2026 As referenced in the headline though, anyone who's subscribed to Xbox Game Pass Ultimate or PC Game Pass won't have to pay a thing to try Valor Mortis on October 13th, as it's included as a "day one" title on the service. It'll hopefully end up being a highlight of October's XGP lineup as well, as the game certainly looks stunning in its trailers and screenshots so far, and it's being developed by the team behind the excellent Ghostrunner games. We'll leave you with a few more details on Valor Mortis below, and look out for it in a few weeks' time! Valor Mortis is a first-person action soulslike from the creators of Ghostrunner. Rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army. Wield supernatural powers, battle horrifying monsters, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens all of humanity. You are William, a soldier of the Grande Armée brought back from a battlefield grave. But the Europe you awaken to is not the one you sacrificed for. A mysterious plague now sweeps the continent, and you have been reborn with its corrupting power pulsing through your veins. Author Profile Reply Comments 1 1 Fiendish-Beaver 4 hours ago I'll be buying the Deluxe Version of this game in support of this developer. I always liked the look of the game, but this move to sell the game at a cheaper price has reinforced my intent to buy the game at the earliest opportunity. The one thing I would say is that we all know that digital games are overpriced from the outset, because most of them are offered on sale for between 10% to 25% off around a month after they initially went on sale. I totally get that the developers want to sell as many copies of their games as they can at full price, but you have to wonder how many more copies they would sell if they priced them more competitively from the outset, and perhaps delayed discounting them in a sale to make up the difference. Anyway, I think far more developers could sell their games more cheaply, and potentially find more success as a result, and I wish One More Level all the success with this game, and they can count on my support... 1 Show Comments Leave A Comment Hold on there, you need to login to post a comment...
